races.paceDynamic: Swindon Village and Top Jimmy will contest the early lead with both confirmed front-runners likely to go a good gallop from the start. Nine horses want prominent positions creating significant traffic congestion through the middle stages, with particular danger at the 3-out and 2-out hurdles where the field will bunch. The honest early pace set by the two leaders will stretch the field out sufficiently to give hold-up horses like Indeevar Bleu, Favour And Fortune, and Rambo T clean runs in the straight. This race shape strongly favours patient hold-up performers who can produce late kicks when the early pace takes its toll.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves honest and sustainable between Swindon Village and Top Jimmy.
scenarios.body: The gallop will string out the field and eliminate the prominent brigade who get caught in traffic, allowing the patient hold-up horses to pick off tired leaders with superior finishing kicks. Sean Bowen can thread Indeevar Bleu through gaps while Tom Bellamy brings Favour And Fortune with a trademark late run.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Position Perfect
scenarios.trigger: If one of the nine prominent runners secures the ideal third or fourth position without getting caught in traffic.
scenarios.body: Wellington Arch or Captain Teague can track the leaders without getting squeezed, then pounce when Swindon Village and Top Jimmy tire in the final furlong. Harry Cobden's big-race experience on Captain Teague could prove decisive in this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Top Jimmy or Swindon Village gets an uncontested lead and maintains stamina.
scenarios.body: The lack of serious early pressure allows one leader to dictate terms and kick clear before the hold-up horses can organize their challenge. Top Jimmy's Grade 1 experience gives him the edge to repel late challengers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners go too fast or one falls, creating a messy scramble.
scenarios.body: The prominent pack becomes bunched and disorganized, with the winner emerging from the chaos rather than tactical superiority. Trustintimes' class could shine through the mayhem despite being rusty from his 104-day break.

watchPoints.text: Swindon Village and Top Jimmy must be monitored early as their pace-setting duel will determine whether hold-up horses get their ideal setup
The prominent pack of nine horses approaching the 3-out hurdle where traffic problems and interference are almost inevitable
Indeevar Bleu's jumping and race-fitness after his 105-day absence, as any early mistake will ruin his hold-up tactics
Trustintimes needs to be sharper than his recent racecourse gallop suggested given his 104-day break from competition
Captain Teague's stamina monitoring after his Cheltenham pull-up, as Harry Cobden may need to ride more conservatively

races.paceDynamic: Regent's Stroll and Miami Magic will ensure a genuine gallop from the off, with both confirmed front runners likely to dispute the early lead. Jordans Cross, Gold Dancer and Crest Of Fortune will track them prominently, keeping the pace honest throughout the 3m1f trip. The soft ground will test stamina reserves in the final half-mile, but the presence of two natural leaders prevents this becoming a sprint. This pace scenario clearly favours the prominent racers and hold-up horses, as the early pace battle between the leaders will set up a strong finish for those tracking and waiting.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Duel Hard
scenarios.trigger: If Regent's Stroll and Miami Magic engage in a sustained battle from the start
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainably strong, compromising both front runners and setting up the race perfectly for closers. Hold-up horses Salver and Wendigo get the perfect tow into contention.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Controlled Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets an easy time in front with the other tracking
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more tactical, suiting prominent racers who can position handily without overexerting. Gold Dancer and Jordans Cross benefit from the manageable tempo.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Early
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders falter or are restrained early, creating a false tempo
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class and acceleration matter more than stamina. The highest-rated horses with tactical speed come to the fore despite their styles.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Miami Magic or Regent's Stroll gets clear and dictates throughout
scenarios.body: One leader controls the race uncontested, building an unassailable advantage that the field cannot peg back. Wire-to-wire victory rewards the brave front running tactics.

races.paceDynamic: Sober Glory and Sinnatra are both confirmed front runners who will contest the early lead, ensuring an honest gallop from the outset. With Sober Glory's superior rating (153) and La Conquiere likely tracking prominently, the pace should be strong but not suicidal over this 2m½f trip. The three hold-up horses (Baron Noir, Starting Fifteen, Storming George) will be relying on the pace to set up their finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours the prominent/tracking horses who can avoid the early battle but stay close enough to pounce when the leaders tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Duel Hard
scenarios.trigger: If Sober Glory and Sinnatra go toe-to-toe from the second flight and maintain a strong gallop throughout.
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will suit Baron Noir and Starting Fifteen who can time their challenges perfectly from off the pace. Both leaders will weaken late, allowing the hold-up horses to sweep past in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sober Glory Dominates Early
scenarios.trigger: If Sober Glory establishes a clear lead with Sinnatra settling behind rather than challenging immediately.
scenarios.body: The class horse gets an easier lead than expected and may prove too good from the front, with La Conquiere best placed to track and challenge. Baron Noir will need the pace to be stronger to be effective from his hold-up style.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Mid-Race
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast early and come back to the field dramatically before the home turn.
scenarios.body: Starting Fifteen and Storming George benefit most from a stop-start gallop that doesn't play to Baron Noir's big-race experience. The lack of consistent pace will frustrate the better horses and create an upset opportunity.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If neither front runner wants the lead and the pace becomes pedestrian from flagfall.
scenarios.body: Baron Noir's class and big-race temperament will prove decisive in a sprint finish, with Sober Glory still dangerous if conserving energy. The lack of pace negates the hold-up horses' usual finishing advantage.

watchPoints.text: Starting Fifteen's 68-day layoff is a major concern for race fitness in a Grade 1 contest requiring peak sharpness.
If Sinnatra allows Sober Glory an uncontested lead early, the class difference may prove decisive.
Baron Noir needs to be prominent turning for home as his hold-up style requires the leaders to come back to him.
La Conquiere must handle the step up in grade but his recent form suggests he's improving at the right time.
Watch how aggressively both front runners go early as it will determine whether the hold-up horses get their ideal scenario.

races.paceDynamic: Gidleigh Park will set a controlled gallop from the front with no other confirmed leaders in the field. Heart Wood, L'Eau du Sud, JPR One, Saint Segal and Solness will settle prominently behind, creating a bunched pack chasing the leader. Grey Dawning will drop out the back as the sole hold-up performer. This sustainable early pace followed by tactical positioning battle from halfway strongly favours prominent racers who can quicken from good positions rather than front-runners or hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays controlled and the prominent horses can position well turning in
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows class to tell as the better prominent racers surge clear from ideal positions. Heart Wood and L'Eau du Sud benefit most from their superior ratings and tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kick Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is too slow and creates a sprint finish from the back
scenarios.body: Grey Dawning's hold-up style becomes a major advantage as he can produce a sustained finish past tiring leaders. His superior class rating of 165 tells late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Gidleigh Park gets an uncontested lead and the chasers wait too long
scenarios.body: The leader maintains his advantage as the prominent horses mark each other rather than commit early enough. Gidleigh Park's recent form and fresh legs from 83-day break prove decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Gidleigh Park goes too fast early or makes jumping errors under pressure
scenarios.body: The race becomes a stop-start affair that suits horses with tactical speed from midfield positions. Solness and JPR One benefit from patient rides and quick acceleration.

races.paceDynamic: Il Est Francais, Ile Atlantique, Conflated, Mahons Glory, Lisnamult Lad and Coming Up Easy will ensure a proper gallop from the start in this large field. With 30 runners and soft ground, the early pace will be searching but may moderate mid-race as the ground takes its toll. The congestion through the middle sections will be severe with 12+ prominent racers fighting for position, creating a stop-start rhythm that will test jumping accuracy. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the early traffic and produce late surges when the pace inevitably fragments.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If the six front-runners maintain their aggressive pace and don't fold on the soft ground
scenarios.body: The relentless tempo will stretch the field and create gaps for the finishers to exploit. Hold-up horses with proven stamina reserves will benefit most from the honest pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders weaken significantly from 4-5 furlongs out due to ground conditions
scenarios.body: The pace will die completely allowing prominent racers to inherit ideal positions turning for home. Those who positioned themselves just behind the speed will have tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Nightmare
scenarios.trigger: If the large field bunches up badly through the middle sections creating interference
scenarios.body: Several fancied runners will get hampered or forced wide, opening doors for those who get clear runs. Horses drawn away from trouble or with luck in running will prosper.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Speed Duel
scenarios.trigger: If multiple pace-setters engage in an early speed battle that burns them all out
scenarios.body: The genuine pace will set up perfectly for closers who stay furthest back early. Low-rated horses with finishing kicks could outrun their odds significantly.

races.paceDynamic: Johnny's Jury, Zeus Power, No Drama This End, Good Girl Kathleen, Talk To The Man and Dalston Lad will ensure a fierce early gallop over this extended trip on testing ground. The combination of six natural front-runners in a 13-runner Grade 1 guarantees serious stamina examination, with the pace likely honest throughout but potentially turning into a war of attrition in the final half-mile. Several of these pace-setters have the class to sustain their effort, but the relentless tempo will create opportunities for the patient hold-up merchants. This race shape strongly favours closers and hold-up horses who can capitalize on the inevitable carnage up front.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front-Runners Battle Hard
scenarios.trigger: If Johnny's Jury, Zeus Power or No Drama This End can dictate without killing each other early
scenarios.body: The classiest pace-setters survive the brutal tempo by virtue of superior ability, with one of the leading trio grinding out victory from those behind who couldn't match their sustained gallop. The winner comes from the established front-runners who proved their stamina reserves are deeper than the rest.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes suicidal and multiple front-runners fold in the closing stages
scenarios.body: Seaniecon and Harbour Island time their runs perfectly as the pace collapses, sweeping past exhausted leaders in the final furlong when stamina reserves are tested to the limit. The patient tactics prove decisive when class horses up front have emptied their tanks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Division Strikes Gold
scenarios.trigger: If Mondoui'boy or Kripticjim avoid the early pace battle while staying close enough
scenarios.body: The prominently-raced horses get the perfect trip tracking the leaders without engaging early, then have enough left to strike when the pace-setters weaken but before the hold-up horses arrive. Perfect positioning proves the winning formula.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If the front six go too fast and burn out collectively in the final mile
scenarios.body: The tempo proves utterly unsustainable with even the classiest leaders capitulating, allowing a big-priced hold-up horse to come from nowhere and steal victory. Shadow Paddy's fresh legs after 174 days off could be crucial in this chaos.

races.paceDynamic: Pourquoi Pas Papa is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms unopposed early, creating a sustainable gallop rather than breakneck speed. The real chaos develops behind as 9 horses crowd the prominent positions - Litleangel Duseuil, Harry Lowes, Captain Ryan Matt, Sherminator, Wandering Ego, Static, Melon, Afadil and Rubber Ball all wanting prime real estate. This congestion will intensify 2-3 hurdles out when the pace quickens, creating traffic problems and blocked runs. The race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can stay out of trouble early and benefit from the guaranteed strong gallop to aim at.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack gets shuffled and blocked 2-3 out as predicted
scenarios.body: The uncontested early pace from Pourquoi Pas Papa sets up perfectly for closers who avoid the traffic mayhem. Wreckless Eric, The Mighty Celt, Star Of Guiting and Last Kingdom can pick off the faltering pace-setters with clear runs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Escapes Trouble
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent pack gets a clear run through the carnage
scenarios.body: Harry Lowes or Sherminator could capitalise on their class if avoiding interference when others get hampered. Their early positioning gives them first shot at Pourquoi Pas Papa before the hold-up horses arrive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Pourquoi Pas Papa maintains kick when challenged and the chasers neutralise each other
scenarios.body: The Charlie Hall fourth proved his stamina over this trip and could exploit the behind-him chaos. His uncontested lead gives him every chance if the finish becomes scrappy.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders get caught up in the prominent traffic jam
scenarios.body: A backmarker like Laafi or Wild Bill Hickok could steal it if the principles eliminate each other. The pace collapse could bring stamina into play over speed.
